title: PI and CMI headings
text: The Product Information uses the headings of the approved form, sections 1 to 10 in order; the CMI uses the summary and the seven headings of the TGA template.

title: Required content is filled
text: Each heading of the PI and the CMI has content.

title: PI title line
text: The PI starts "AUSTRALIAN PRODUCT INFORMATION –" followed by the trade name, the active ingredient and the dosage form.

title: Black triangle scheme
text: Medicines in the scheme show the ▼ and the standard statement at the top of the first page of the PI and the CMI for five years; others do not.

title: Standard PI statements
text: Section 4.8 points to www.tga.gov.au/reporting-problems, section 4.9 gives the Poisons Information Centre number 13 11 26, section 7 gives the Poisons Standard schedule (for example "Prescription Only Medicine (Schedule 4)"), and sections 9 and 10 give dates.
simplified: The app checks the reporting address and the Poisons Information Centre number rather than the full paragraphs.

title: Standard CMI statements
text: The CMI summary opens with the standard introduction; section 6 carries the standard side-effect sentences and the TGA reporting statement; section 7 ends with "This leaflet was prepared in" and the month and year.

title: The summary fits on one page
text: The CMI summary is a single page: the most important information at a glance.
simplified: Estimated at 45 lines of about 90 characters.
